# CATEGORY A — 65% MATRIX-WIDE MONEY-IN KPI — CURRENT OWNER DIRECTION

**Current target: 65%.** This is the Owner's latest instruction and supersedes the prior 45% request, the earlier 33% request, and the historic 25%/75% Librarian allocation as current KPI wording. Those prior records remain historical provenance only.

**Current Blue State:** `AMX/ROOT/BLUE_STATE/BLUE_STATE_MANDATE_BINDING_AND_PREFLIGHT_V1.md`, blob `cda4da372801a91debf3a9c71b8c8ebbf33b4114`.
**Current detail:** [CATEGORY_A_MATRIX_WIDE_MONEY_IN_FOCUS_65_PERCENT_SUPERSESSION_20261013.md](https://github.com/amillimatrix-eng/CARBON-Creation-Hub/blob/main/AMX/ROOT/INTAKE/CATEGORY_A_MATRIX_WIDE_MONEY_IN_FOCUS_65_PERCENT_SUPERSESSION_20261013.md), blob `98003d58dc606622dfe7eb5c330f480373d178fd`.
**Prior 45% artifact (historical):** [CATEGORY_A_MATRIX_WIDE_MONEY_IN_FOCUS_45_PERCENT_SUPERSESSION_20261013.md](https://github.com/amillimatrix-eng/CARBON-Creation-Hub/blob/main/AMX/ROOT/INTAKE/CATEGORY_A_MATRIX_WIDE_MONEY_IN_FOCUS_45_PERCENT_SUPERSESSION_20261013.md).

## 1. Exact KPI meaning

For every autonomous Matrix worker, including Librarians, **65% of the worker's evaluated performance/KPI** measures attributable contribution toward verified money-in or the evidenced removal of a real blocker on that path. The remaining **35%** measures the worker's existing governed mandate and responsibilities.

This is a performance-accountability weight, **not a 65% wall-clock, time, compute, staffing, activity, or blanket sales quota**. It does not expand a worker's mandate or transfer ownership. Contribution must be attributable, observable, and evidence-backed.

## 2. Outcome truth

Keep these states separate:
- **Verified money-in:** received/withdrawable funds or settlement independently verified.
- **Lifecycle progress:** qualified response, accepted work, contract, invoice/receivable, submission/award, delivery acceptance, or another source-backed state change.
- **Attributable enabling progress:** a worker removes a specific evidenced blocker directly preventing a money path.
- **Activity only:** wake, report, prompt edit, candidate list, draft, raw application, nominal bounty value, unaccepted deliverable, or unverified payment claim.

Activity alone is not money-in. Enabling progress must be labelled as progress, not cash. Do not double-count one outcome or assert causality without evidence.

## 3. Keep the 60/20/20 sourcing allocation separate

The existing **60/20/20** rule applies only to effort within opportunity sourcing/search:
- 60% real-value/direct-buyer work;
- 20% qualifying Micro-Matrix work;
- 20% maximum recruitment/platform-led sourcing.

It is not the 65% KPI or a Matrix-wide time/compute quota. Inbound and accepted offers are outside the sourcing allocation; do not delay them because a sourcing slice is full. Progress each from its furthest source-verified lifecycle stage using existing iSCOPE → PRI → Banker ownership where applicable.

## 4. Every-flight reporting

The current Blue State requires every run to state its objective, why it matters now, and its observable pass test before material work. Every post-flight report must state **PASS or FAIL**, why, proof/readback, the 65% KPI result, and one concrete next action. PASS requires all mandatory tests and independent readback. Any unmet or unknown required test means FAIL. Each run also includes the existing FORX 13-head review and routes its actionable results through existing Root Intake as Category B.

## 5. Existing ownership and acceptance conditions

- **ROOT/T-GOV:** governs/dispositions the supersession and keeps Blue State, this issue, and Intake Index aligned.
- **MASTER/LIBRARIAN + FORX:** verifies per-worker receipt and behavior samples; no universal-adoption claim from prompt text alone.
- **Each existing worker:** applies 65/35 semantics within its own mandate and separates activity, enabling progress, lifecycle progress, and money received.
- **Existing commercial owners:** preserve 60/20/20 and progress existing inbound/accepted opportunities truthfully.
- **Acceptance evidence:** current Blue State and this issue read back as 65%; Index points to the 65% artifact; Registry v1.2 root and all registered mandate payload hashes remain unchanged; per-worker behavioral samples are read back; money-in is credited only on independent settlement evidence.

**Current status:** Blue State and the 65% artifact are written and independently read back. This issue is being updated to the 65% target. Index and ROOT issue #31 must be read back after their updates. Matrix-wide worker adoption is not yet proven. No revenue is claimed from this governance change.

**Historical supersession chain:** 25%/75% → 33% request → 45% Owner request → **65% current Owner direction**. Historical artifacts are not deleted or rewritten to hide prior states.

## Same-run money-in discovery/qualification — 2026-10-12 (SAST)

This updates the existing Category A request, not a new queue or worker. The country-origin/legitimacy rule is applied only to income opportunities; it does not constrain continuity-drive mapping/noding/weighting.

### Results that change ranking

**1. Current South Africa micro-work route — TELUS Digital Online Data Analyst**
- Official role page remains live: https://jobs.telusdigital.com/jobs/18301194-online-data-analyst-south-africa
- Primary-source readback says freelance/part-time map-data verification, standard assessment, and five consecutive years' residence in South Africa are required.
- This is an existing ledger provider/role, not a newly discovered independent source. It remains an application/assessment route, not assigned work or earnings. Keep distinct from other providers; preserve the existing OTP/identity/application gate. No new application was sent.

**2. OneForma — existing provider, not multiple independent income routes**
- Official payout rules: https://www.oneforma.com/help-center/payment-issues-and-finance/how-payments-work-on-oneforma/
- Pay cycle is project-dependent weekly/bi-weekly; typically 2–3 business days after cycle when a payout account is connected; typical minimum USD $10 equivalent; Payoneer/PayPal/Tipalti are region-dependent.
- Existing South Africa qualification case CAS-76245-N9W2F5 has no substantive project/rate/eligibility answer in the last recorded mail reconciliation. No task assignment is evidenced. Do not rank its project count as cash-ready opportunity volume.

**3. Prolific — legitimate but not a near-term cash route while waitlisted**
- Official cash-out instructions: https://participant-help.prolific.com/en/articles/445062-how-do-i-cash-out-on-prolific
- A low cash-out threshold is not enough to make it executable; researcher approval can keep rewards pending, and the current account/study access gate remains decisive. Existing ledger status remains deprioritized pending actual access and current study availability.

**4. Web3: 1inch Infrastructure Bug Bounty — real, rules-defined, but low-probability and capability-gated**
- Official Immunefi program: https://immunefi.com/bug-bounty/1inch-infrastructure/information/
- Page was current to 9 Oct 2026; indicates USDC on Ethereum payouts, KYC required, proof-of-concept required, and a USD $20,000 maximum with tiered rewards. This is a bounty for a valid in-scope security vulnerability—not paid hourly work and not a reward for simply participating.
- Public 1inch Business terms name Degensoft Ltd, BVI: https://business.1inch.com/portal/terms-of-service. That helps identify a related legal entity, but the evidence retrieved here does not conclusively bind that entity to this exact bounty's paying counterparty. **Disposition: HOLD for payer/entity binding and only advance if an in-scope issue is actually supported by existing authorized testing capability.** No probing, exploit, account/KYC disclosure or wallet transaction was performed. Do not put this ahead of direct paid pilots.

### Rejected/discounted noise

- Superteam “Explain Market Tokenization in Your Country” page: https://superteam.fun/earn/listing/explain-market-tokenization-in-your-country — despite a displayed 5,500 USDC prize headline and global eligibility, its rules explicitly say winners receive a Breakpoint ticket **in place of the prize amount; no cash**. It also showed 94 submissions and announcement on 13 Oct. **REJECT for money-in.**
- Superteam's older high-headline listings that were checked in this run were either Canada-only, past their winner dates, dependent on attending an already-completed event, or required buying/holding a token. They are not counted as current withdrawable-money routes.
- Current Superteam agent/content contests are competitive winner pools, not paid task contracts. A USDC label or total prize pool does not mean a participant has a receivable. Do not advance them unless sponsor/payer origin, live deadline, rules and payout are verified and expected net value beats direct buyer work.
- A PeoplePerHour AI automation listing advertising about USD $374 was not independently inspectable because the page served an anti-bot interstitial; the accessible card alone did not establish the buyer/payee identity or funding/escrow state. After that bounded verification attempt, **DISCARD rather than leave active HOLD**. No bid was made.
- Recent Reddit “for-hire” search results were supply-side developer adverts, not buyers offering to pay. Excluded as non-opportunities.

### Existing global crypto inventory
Latest confirmed first-party Agent Bounties snapshot in the existing Category A record is dated 11 Oct: 0 claimable, 0 verification-ready and $0 funded USDC; some nominal items were explicitly not verifier-ready. The 12 Oct external refresh was not independently read back in this run, so this remains **stale prior evidence, not a claim about today's inventory**. Do not count nominal mirror/feed entries until current primary inventory, eligibility, payout and settlement route are independently read back.

### Direct paid-pilot lane
- Existing canonical opportunities remain the priority: Kingston Stanley ($99 / 48-hour sourcing overflow pilot) and Xubio ($49 / 48-hour onboarding support pilot) already sent and followed up once; OnTrack Mulching cleanup offer sent; JobNect/KJ Plumbing remain delivery-delayed; Colonia Estudio, Cork City Gaol and Cuina Teva were rejected/closed to unsolicited follow-up; MPRTC route is known wrong/unmonitored. Respect each record's current contact state—do not re-contact merely because revenue is slow.
- The two existing Upwork briefs (USD $700 RAG/CRM build and USD $1,000 WhatsApp/GHL agent) remain gated on a truthful live demo/source proof and authorized authenticated proposal route. Do not call either applied or qualified.
- The public searches in this bounded run produced no additional direct buyer brief that met all requirements (identifiable payer, live scope, feasible route from South Africa and credible short path to withdrawable payment). Supply-side posts and expired posts were excluded. This is not a claim that no such buyer exists; discovery remains open.

### Execution/acceptance report
- **New routes fully qualified as near-term withdrawable money:** 0.
- **New Web3 route held for one bounded verification / capability gate:** 1 (1inch Infrastructure Bounty).
- **Rejected as non-cash, stale/ineligible, unverifiable, or supply-side noise:** multiple, as above.
- **Applications, bids, outreach, purchases, wallet transactions or paid tasks executed in this research pass:** 0.
- **Revenue or Owner repayment evidenced by this pass:** $0. No repayment is claimed.
- **Next actions:** maintain focus on current warm/direct pilot responses and current unblocked paid-task gates; recheck live microtask availability via first-party routes; get current funded/claimable bounty inventory via its authorized API surface; only retain Web3 candidates with scope fit and transparent payer/control/settlement. Continue to reject unverifiable offerings after one bounded public-source check.

The 33% allocation remains a governance request until ROOT/T-GOV disposition and per-worker consumption/behavioral receipts are read back. The Intake-index append attempt is still blocked by tool safety checks; this comment remains attached to existing Issue #34 and no alternate write path was used.

- **Owners:** ROOT/T-GOV — decide and bind the 33% request; T-COD / existing Intake Index owner — reconcile the stale 66-vs-83 line against the current 86-key ledger while preserving historical run provenance; iSCOPE — recheck discovery/qualification holds; PRI — reconcile existing commercial threads, due dates and next actions; Banker remains the independent source for payment/settlement truth.

- **Acceptance evidence:** canonical readback showing the accepted allocation; index correction readback; each affected record has a verified state, owner, NEXT_ACTION and DUE/waiting condition; current run/receipt separates listings, submissions, acceptance, invoice, payment and withdrawable settlement.
- **Persistence/readback:** this comment is persisted in existing Issue #34; independent comment readback required after posting. It does not itself change Canon or prove worker propagation.
- **Safety/preservation:** no duplicate worker, queue, scheduler, external contact, account, or paid spend; preserve single-writer and historical evidence; no stage inflation.
